newsitem.title: USA: Cable extends Bell Cable, NYNEX cable tender.
newsitem.headline: Cable extends Bell Cable, NYNEX cable tender.

text.p: Cable & Wireless Communications said Thursday it extended its offer for Bell Cablemedia Plc and NYNEX Corp's CableComms Group in Great Britain and the United States.
The offer will expire September 15, unless further extended, the company said.

Cable & Wireless is uniting its Mercury Communications Ltd subsidiary and three cable television units of NYNEX and Bell Cablemedia to form Britain's biggest cable company, Cable & Wireless Communications. CWC will serve about 1.2 million telephony customers and 580,000 cable television customers.

Its offer has been completed and CWC owns 100 percent of the shares in Bell Cablemedia and NYNEX CableComms. The extension of the subsequent offer period applies to unexpired and unexercised options in Bell Cablemedia and NYNEX CableComms, a CWC spokeswoman said.
